author: ChilledWildfire
quote:
Have been Grand Theft Auto from my childhood. You could steal cars, do illegal stuffs, have fun with friends and after GTA V, I would come home, do my chores, sit down and have some fun stealing vehicles and cruising through the City. People are complaining about the Graphics, but graphics are top notch. But graphics doesn't alone dictate the game, else everyone would be playing Runescapes instead of Valheim. 

GTA VI killed the true essence of any GTA game type and mechanics. It's like playing SIMS with superior Graphics. Hate to see such a downfall.
